$comment: The ONE place for the Windows-facing names of the server edition. Read by src/server-edition/names.ts (runtime, karizctl), scripts/build-server.mjs, packaging/server/scripts/*.ps1 (install, services, smoke test) and the WiX build (passed as -d defines). Internal identifiers (sm_ tables, itsm.* settings, ITSM_* variables) never derive from these names. Never change upgradeCode: it ties every later MSI to the installed product.
